Bash(python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.read_excel\('data/BASE DE DADOS PEDE 2024 - DATATHON.xlsx'\)
target = \(df['Defas'] < 0\).astype\(int\)

print\('=== Correlação com o target ==='\)
for col in ['IAN','INDE 22','IDA','IEG','IPV','IAA','Matem','Portug','Defas']:
    corr = df[col].corr\(target\)
    print\(f'  {col:12s}: {corr:.4f}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== IAN vs Defas \(crosstab\) ==='\)
print\(pd.crosstab\(df['Defas'], df['IAN'].round\(1\)\).to_string\(\)\)

print\(\)
print\('=== IAN distribução por classe ==='\)
print\('defasado=1:', df.loc[target==1,'IAN'].describe\(\)\)
print\('no nivel=0:', df.loc[target==0,'IAN'].describe\(\)\)

print\(\)
print\('IAN único < 0:', \(df['IAN'] < 0\).sum\(\)\)
print\('IAN == Defas?:', \(df['IAN'] == df['Defas']\).all\(\)\)
print\('IAN vs Defas sample:'\)
print\(df[['IAN','Defas']].head\(20\).to_string\(\)\)
")
